label: D1 after a reward, late in episode (trial 90+), while leaning toward a2, in a reward streak
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1. It is almost entirely confined to the last ~10 trials of the episode (99% of mass at ep_trial 90-99, where the value head output falls below 5.2), and only when the agent is about to pick a2 (5599 of 5600 activations have upcoming action a2; the policy logit sits in the moderate a2-leaning bin [-4.4,-1.5]). That bin is the agent s own policy, not a future variable. Mostly good=S2 (starts high episodes). Magnitude grows over a run of consecutive rewarded a2 trials (e.g. 0.06 -> 0.38 -> 0.62 -> 0.81) and drops off after an unrewarded trial, so requiring the previous trial to be rewarded too (or to fall outside the window) lifts precision from 0.50 to 0.62 with recall 0.98. Never fires at GO or D2, after no reward, before trial ~85, or when the agent is going to pick a1. Dev F1 0.76: precision is incomplete because many late rewarded a2 D1 steps stay silent, which probably reflects how long the streak is and where the steps fall in the episode. I recorded the observed-only predicate, using the policy logit in place of the future action; it scores slightly better than action==2 (F1 0.72).
